description_en: Upgrades the minor database version of a MongoDB instance
description_zh: 升级MongoDB实例的数据库小版本
name: UpgradeDBInstanceKernelVersion

parameters.help_en:
The upgrade mode for the instance version. Valid values:
0: immediate upgrade
1: upgrade within the maintenance window
parameters.help_zh:
实例版本升级模式。取值：

0：立即升级。
1：在可运维时间段内升级
parameters.name: switch_mode

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can generate the value of this parameter on the client side. The value must be unique across different requests and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length. The value cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符，且该参数值中不能包含非 ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without calling the operation. The system checks items such as request parameters, request format, business limits, and inventory. If the request fails the check, the corresponding error is returned. If the request passes the check, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.
false: sends a normal request and directly performs the operation if the request passes the check.
Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否对本次请求执行预检查，取值：
true：执行预检查，不真正调用该接口。检查项包含请求参数、请求格式、业务限制和库存等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误；如果检查通过，则返回错误码 DryRunOperation。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接执行本次操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The instance type. If you set this parameter to "search", the search node is upgraded. If you do not specify this parameter, the original regular nodes in the instance are upgraded
parameters.help_zh: 实例类型，传入"search"表示升级 Search 节点；若不传，则升级实例中原有的常规节点
parameters.name: character_type
